summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new features for Backyard Ultra Santo Domingo 2026: DNF logic (no lap increment), revert lap with DNF reactivation, followers count API, and cheer messages system. All 15 backend tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified cheer modal, cheer feed, and admin panel followers column.
critical_code_review_comments: DNF logic correctly implemented: mark_retired does NOT increment laps_completed - athlete keeps their current lap count
Revert lap correctly reactivates DNF athletes with same lap count (not decremented) when retired_at_lap >= new_lap
Followers count API correctly aggregates active subscriptions per athlete using MongoDB aggregation pipeline
Cheer messages have proper validation: max 280 chars for message, max 50 chars for fan name
Cheer feed enriches messages with athlete names and nationality for display
seed_data_creation: Created test subscriptions and cheer messages during testing. Current state: 89 active athletes, 1 DNF (Cristian Minaya - reactivated), current lap 1
context_for_next_testing_agent: New features tested: 1) DNF does NOT increment laps - verified via API and UI, 2) Revert lap reactivates DNF athletes with same lap count, 3) Followers count API requires auth and returns {bib: count} dict, 4) Cheer messages: POST /api/race/cheer (no auth), GET /api/race/cheers (no auth), GET /api/race/cheers/count (no auth). Frontend has cheer buttons in athlete table, cheer feed modal, and admin panel shows Seguidores column with follower counts.

Revert Lap: reactivates DNF athletes with same lap count ✓

Followers Count: returns dict of bib -> count ✓

Cheer modal opens with athlete name and form fields ✓
Cheer feed button visible when messages exist ✓
Cheer feed modal shows messages with fan name, athlete info, timestamp ✓

Admin panel: Reactivate button shows warning dialog ✓

dnf_revert.evidence: Backend test verified reactivation preserves lap count
